corrections.finding: The source establishes that the accent role uses a color token. A role's association with a token does not by itself prove it is a narrower kind of token. The draft correctly flags process-versus-object ambiguity in color-serialization -> color-tokens; this role-versus-token edge deserves the same explicit semantic treatment.
corrections.recommendedChange: Add an unresolved semantic flag and define whether parenthood means topic containment or an is-a relation. Under contextual topic containment, a narrowly defined token-role leaf may be justified; otherwise consider a color-role parent or separate related relation. Preserve the narrow contextual éclat alias rather than broadening it to all color tokens.
corrections.resolution: No forced flattening is warranted. Source-backed definitions and inherited topic meanings must be reviewed before adopting this edge.

limitations: This cross-review is an independent semantic source check, not executable schema validation, runtime acceptance, source-owner approval or a live human approval.

Source standing, eventual fixture-record lifecycle and accepted subject classification require separate declarations. Null lifecycle findings are unresolved draft representations, not assertions that an accepted source is unreliable.
